overview_description.description: MovitOn is a Web3-based peer-to-peer delivery and travelers’ marketplace platform that aims to connect senders with travelers and couriers for faster and more affordable global deliveries. The platform combines blockchain technology, smart contracts, and AI-driven logistics tools to facilitate cross-border delivery of documents, electronics, medical items, valuables, and other packages.
